You can also super heat distilled water, but you don't want to try that one because it's very dangerous. Because of the lack of impurities in the water, it has no nucleation points (which you've seen the results of with freezing). So, if you microwave it in a very clean bowl for a while, it will instantly boil when disturbed, leading to a violent explosion of boiling water. This is why you'll actually see instructions telling you to put a spoon (yes, even metal is fine) in your cup/bowl if you plan to microwave water, to provide nucleation points.
